content_of_post_to_comment:
I'm 23M working as a salesman in my family shop since last 15 years. I've lived mostly as instruction based life because lack of awareness, exposure, guidance.

I've lived most of my life in eat, sleep open and close shop, handle sales and repeat basis,no other activities outside it . Currently I'm feeling lonely, behind and most importantly not able to direct myself due to issues like procrastination, perfectionism,lack of tolerance .

My father's shop giving me stable income,even if I don't do anything then also my life will go on how it's going but it will leave me with regret of not doing , trying and growing financially and personally .

I'm going through a very bad phase as per health basis post Covid both physically and mentally, I'm having health issues one by one and that too chronic diseases like keratoconus, epilepsy, thalassemia and even if having these serious issues not taking care of my health. Living in same routine comfort zone is also draining me from inside and my mind is craving for growth not only financially but learning, socially, experience wise also .

Currently I'm scared of living alone all my life because of such health issues and never expected I'll have to live in such a way and I don't think anyone will accept me if she knows about me . I have never learnt what self love is and always wished of having someone who will love me but I don't think it's possible anymore and this thought is scaring me alot and draining me emotionally.

I don't know how i will overcome from this phase and what will happen next but I'm not want to live like this anymore

If you are reading this then I'm really need your advice, how can I overcome from this and start living in a better way.

Thank you 🙏
comment: Working in your father's shop since childhood probably gave you stability, but it also sounds like you never got the chance to build an identity outside that routine. Don't try to fix your entire life at once. Start with small promises to yourself: a walk, learning something for 20 minutes, meeting one person. Also, your health conditions don't make you unlovable; the right people will see you beyond your diagnoses.
